{{Quote|The two, a Captain Ganig and a Sergeant Stecker, are both inside the station. COMPNOR made each famous after the Battle of Sagma, but since then their casual observation of doctrine has come to light.|Mar Barezz|<ref name="ISB">{{WEGCite|story=Picutorion Viewed From the Top|book=Imperial Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Sagma''' was an engagement of the [[Listehol Campaign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Reconquest of the Rim]] that took place in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sagma system/Legends|Sagma system]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. In the battle, Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bannidge Holt]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruisers]] augmented by [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln space superiority starfighters]]. The Imperial force faced a swarm of [[Sikurdian privateers/Legends|Sikurdian pirates]] and emerged victorious. After the Battle of Sagma, the Empire's [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] made Captain [[Ganig]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Stecker]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] famous heroes.

==Prelude==
[[File:YularenAttitude-CoD.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Admiral Wullf Yularen (pictured) and Captain Bannidge Holt commanded a Galactic Empire fleet at the Battle of Sagma.]]
By [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], a union was formed between [[Sikurdian privateers/Legends|pirates]] of the [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> and [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] of the [[Tervig]] and [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]]<ref name="EGTW" /> species.<ref name="CSWE Tervissis">{{CSWECite|III|233|Tervissis}}</ref><ref name="EGTW" /> The united gangs carried out raids in<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&ndash;allied<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and endangered commercial shipping along the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Consequently, in 18 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the Empire launched the [[Listehol Campaign]] as part of its [[Reconquest of the Rim]]. Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] was given a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of ancient [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruisers]] originally reserved for the Corporate Sector, which he and the young [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bannidge Holt]] complemented with a small number of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==The battle==
In the [[Sagma system/Legends|Sagma system]]<ref name="EGTW" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> the Imperial fleet [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by Yularen and Holt faced a swarm of Sikurdian [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Launching [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln space superiority starfighters]] from the Venators, the Imperial force prevailed in the engagement.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Aftermath==
Advancing along<ref name="EGTW" /> the Listehol Run,<ref name="TEA" /> Yularen and Holt's fleet subsequently passed through the [[Sikurd system/Legends|Sikurd system]] before going on to [[Siege of Zygerria|interdict]]<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]].<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|locations|zygerria|Zygerria}}</ref> After the Battle of Sagma, the Empire's [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] made Captain [[Ganig]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Stecker]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] famous heroes, a fact that [[Mar Barezz]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] later noted to Imperial [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Bevven]] and [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]] [[Theol Drost]] during a [[Raid on Picutorion|battle]] fought on<ref name="ISB" /> the planet<ref name="THW1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin1|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1}}</ref> [[Picutorion/Legends|Picutorion]]<ref name="ISB" /> by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="17 BBY">Per {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin1|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1}}, the [[Raid on Picutorion]] took place before [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] was fitted with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthetic parts, which {{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}} dates to [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Impsourcebook.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Battle of Sagma was introduced in the ''Imperial Sourcebook''.]]
The Battle of Sagma was first mentioned in "[[Picutorion Viewed From the Top]]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' that was written by [[Greg Gorden]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], subsequently noted a [[Battle of the Sagma system|battle]] in the Sagma [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;in which the Galactic Empire was victorious&mdash;on a map of [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] engagements taking place between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

On that map, the Sagma system battle was placed spatially close to Galactic Civil War battles in the [[Praadost system/Legends|Praadost]], [[Doniphon system/Legends|Doniphon]], and [[Telos system/Legends|Telos systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Fry's [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Miniatures|''Star Wars'' Miniatures]] scenario series ''[[The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale]]'', published on [[Wizards.com]] between [[December 2]], [[2004]]<ref name="THW1" /> and [[January 27]], [[2005]],<ref name="THWC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin5|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Conclusion|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Conclusion}}</ref> had previously established that the Imperial campaign known as the [[Kwymar Suppressions/Legends|Kwymar Suppressions]]&mdash;preceded by the [[pacification of Praadost II]]&mdash;included engagements on the celestial bodies [[Assault on Doniphon|Doniphon]] and [[Battle of Telos IV (Kwymar Suppressions)|Telos]]<ref name="THW1" /> as well as the battle on Picutorion<ref name="THW1" /><ref name="THWC" /> which, per "Picutorion Viewed From the Top," took place after the Battle of Sagma.<ref name="ISB" /> In addition, ''The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale'' established that the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] had participated in the Picutorion battle before being wounded and fitted with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthetic parts.<ref name="THW1" />

[[File:SagmaGCW-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Material authored for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' retroactively established that the Galactic Civil War battle in the Sagma system noted in ''The Essential Atlas'' was an engagement separate from the Battle of Sagma.]]
However, the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], introduced a "Battle of Sagma" in which the Empire was also victorious but which was set in 18 BBY.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Furthermore, a section was created for the book in which Valance's fitting with cybernetics was dated to 17 BBY. Although the section was cut from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', it was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}}</ref> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book. Thereby, the Picutorion battle was also dated to approximately 17 BBY, and the Galactic Civil War battle in the Sagma system from ''The Essential Atlas'' was [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] established to have been a separate engagement from the Battle of Sagma from "Picutorion Viewed From the Top."<ref name="Author's Cut" />
